lines.en: label saraspecial30p1:
scene returnofaweirdcouple1
We make it back to the bar thanks to my incredible strength and unflappable willpower.
lines.zh: 多亏我惊人的力气和不可动摇的意志力，我们总算把东西弄回了酒吧。

lines.en: : You know, I get that I’m a lot stronger than you, but {i}any{/i} amount of help at all would be nice.
lines.zh: : 我知道我比你强壮得多，但你好歹{i}搭把手{/i}也行啊。

lines.en: We make it back to the bar thanks to my incredible strength and unflappable willpower.
lines.zh: 多亏我惊人的力气和不可动摇的意志力，我们总算把东西弄回了酒吧。

lines.en: : Hey! You actually managed to pull it off! And saved me like 5,000 yen on shipping in the process!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你居然真办成了！还替我省了大概五千日元的运费！

lines.en: : I would have just paid that if it meant not having to carry it back with us on a motorcycle.
lines.zh: : 要是那样就不用扛着这玩意儿跟我们骑摩托回来，我宁愿付那笔钱。

lines.en: : Says the dude who just pressed this shit against my shoulders the whole way here.
lines.zh: : 这话从一路把这破东西压在我肩膀上的家伙嘴里说出来，真有说服力。

lines.en: : It’s not my fault you have an incredibly strong back. I would have lost my balance if I had to hold it and there is a girl with twintails at my house who would go on a rampage if I died.
lines.zh: : 谁让你背这么结实。我要是拿着它就会失去平衡，而且我家里还有个双马尾的丫头，我要是死了她会原地暴走。

lines.en: : My decision to push all of the responsibility and effort onto you is one that may have very well saved the world, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我把所有责任和力气都推给你这个决定，搞不好可是拯救了世界，Yuki。

lines.en: : Bite me.
lines.zh: : 咬我啊。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple2
: Where do you want this thing? Also, {i}why{/i} do you want this thing? Can’t get hammered off of fuckin’ espresso.
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿你想放哪儿？还有，你{i}为什么{/i}要这玩意儿？喝浓缩咖啡又他妈喝不醉。

lines.en: : It’s a dessert thing. You know, for like Irish coffee and whatnot. Plus, it can also help people sober up so they spend more money.
lines.zh: : 这是做甜点用的。你知道的，爱尔兰咖啡什么的。再说了，它还能帮人醒酒，这样他们就能花更多钱。

lines.en: : Sure, it might take a few months to pay off, but it’ll work out in the long run...hopefully.
lines.zh: : 确实，可能要几个月才能回本，但长远来看会赚回来的……希望吧。

lines.en: : You can stash it in the backroom next to all of the holiday stuff in the meantime, though.
lines.zh: : 在那之前你先把它塞进后屋，跟那堆节日用品放一块儿就行。

lines.en: : Anything else, my lord?
lines.zh: : 还有别的事吗，我的大人？

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple3
: You could help clean so {i}I{/i} can have a turn with Sensei now?
lines.zh: : 你能不能帮忙打扫一下，好让{i}我{/i}现在也能轮到一次 Sensei？

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. Ain’t I supposed to be off right now? Do I really gotta clean?
lines.zh: : 等等，先别急。我现在不该是下班了吗？我真得打扫吗？

lines.en: : The last customers left like twenty minutes ago and I’ve done most of the work. Just mop the floors and I’ll let you come in a few hours later tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 最后一批客人二十分钟前就走了，而且大部分活我都干完了。你把地拖一下，明天我让你晚来几个小时。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple4
: Say no more. So much better not havin’ to deal with customers. I’ll take cleaning over that any day of the week.
lines.zh: : 别说了。不用应付客人简直好太多了。一周里随便哪天我都选打扫。

lines.en: : Oh, and don’t be too rough with the guy during your {i}turn.{/i} He’s fragile.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，{i}轮到你{/i}的时候别对他太粗暴。他很脆弱。

lines.en: : I am fragile by choice because it makes life easier.
lines.zh: : 我是出于自愿才脆弱的，因为这样活起来轻松。

lines.en: : Did you have a fun trip? Yuki’s told me before you’re afraid of motorcycles. Was it better or worse than you expected?
lines.zh: : 你这趟还开心吗？Yuki 之前跟我说过你怕摩托车。比你想的好还是糟？

lines.en: : Worse. I am in no rush to ever do that again and am glad to be on land once more.
lines.zh: : 更糟。我一点都不急着再来一次，能重新踩在陆地上我很庆幸。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple5
: I’m glad you’re back on land as well. There’s more than one girl who might go on a murderous rampage if you wind up disappearing, you know.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴你回到陆地上。你要是就这么消失了，可不止一个女孩会陷入杀人狂暴状态，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Hell hath no fury like a lonely bartender abandoned by two teachers she wound up unintentionally falling for.
lines.zh: : 地狱的烈焰也敌不过一个被两个她无意间爱上的老师抛弃的寂寞酒保的怒火。

lines.en: : I am quite positive that is not how that phrase is supposed to go.
lines.zh: : 我非常确定那句话原本不是这么说的。

lines.en: : You have a few minutes to go upstairs? There’s something I wanted to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 你有几分钟上楼吗？我有件事想跟你谈。

lines.en: : Am I in trouble? Because it sounds like I’m in trouble.
lines.zh: : 我有麻烦了吗？听起来像是我有麻烦了。

lines.en: : It’s nothing like that. It’s just not really something I want to discuss in front of Yuki since I don’t want her to think I’m insane.
lines.zh: : 不是那种事。只是我不想当着 Yuki 的面说，因为我不想让她觉得我疯了。

lines.en: : But it’s okay if {i}I{/i} think you’re insane?
lines.zh: : 那{i}我{/i}觉得你疯了就可以？

lines.en: : I mean, I’d {i}prefer{/i} that you don’t think I’m insane. But I’m pretty confident I would have scared you off already if you weren’t at least {i}somewhat{/i} open to letting me lean on you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我{i}更希望{/i}你别把我看成疯子。但我挺有把握，如果你不是至少{i}有点{/i}愿意让我依靠，你早就被我吓跑了。

lines.en: : Is something-
lines.zh: : 是有什么——

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple6
: Ah-ah-ah. {i}Upstairs.{/i}
lines.zh: : 啊——啊——啊。{i}上楼{/i}再说。

lines.en: : You can ask me whatever you want once we’re in my apartment.
lines.zh: : 等我们进了我的公寓，你想问什么都可以问。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m sure you’ll have a lot of questions.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会有一大堆问题。

lines.en: We move up the creaky staircase, each step louder than the one before it, as it becomes clear to me that the Sara I know and the Sara currently guiding me are not the same person.
lines.zh: 我们踩着吱呀作响的楼梯往上走，每一级都比前一级更响，而我也渐渐明白，我所认识的那个 Sara，和此刻领着我上楼的这个 Sara，并不是同一个人。

lines.en: Would it be presumptuous to assume that I have something to do with this? That my recent push for Yuki’s approval has caught her eye in some way?
lines.zh: 假设这跟我有关，会不会太自以为是？我最近为求得 Yuki 认可所做的努力，是不是以某种方式被她看在了眼里？

lines.en: Have I become the cracks in those fractured emerald gems she locks within her skull — reflecting a world that has forsaken her, in a town in which she’ll die?
lines.zh: 我是否已然成为她嵌在颅骨里那些碎裂的翡翠宝石上的裂纹——映照出一个背弃了她的世界，映照出她将死去的那座小镇？

lines.en: Does the creaking of the seventh step usurp the role of “coda” in the sense that it is there where fragments of the end break apart and fall from her retinal glass?
lines.zh: 第七级台阶的吱呀声，是否篡夺了“终章”的角色——因为正是在那里，终局的碎片从她视网膜的玻璃上剥落、坠落？

lines.en: My hand finds a railing but the railing is her hand.
lines.zh: 我的手找到了一根扶手，但那扶手是她的手。

lines.en: And I become a shadow hiding from the sun as the door to her abode opens and shuns me.
lines.zh: 当她居所的门开启又把我拒之门外时，我成了一道躲避阳光的影子。

lines.en: There is something buried underneath our feet.
lines.zh: 我们脚下埋着什么东西。

lines.en: It may very well swallow us whole.
lines.zh: 它很可能会把我们整个吞下。

lines.en: But in those sparing moments before we are digested, we shapeshift into bloodworms, spilling ourselves all over the hands that hold us up.
lines.zh: 但在被消化的那短暂间隙里，我们化作了血虫，把自己满满地泼洒在那双托举着我们的手上。

lines.en: And we drink in the idea that, one day, we will be able to live without the fear of falling.
lines.zh: 我们畅饮着这样一个念头：总有一天，我们能不必再恐惧坠落地活下去。

lines.en: It is during the creaking of the seventh step that I remember where I am and where I’m going.
lines.zh: 正是在第七级台阶的吱呀声中，我想起了自己身在何处、要去何方。

lines.en: It is during the break in the eighth that I close my eyes.
lines.zh: 正是在第八级的断裂处，我闭上了眼睛。

lines.en: And in the moaning of the ninth that I am consumed.
lines.zh: 而在第九级的呻吟里，我被吞噬。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple7
: This isn’t about Yuki and me, is it?
lines.zh: : 这不是关于 Yuki 和我的事，对吧？

lines.en: : What’s that supposed to mean? Did the two of you hold hands while I wasn’t looking or something? Am I supposed to punish you now?
lines.zh: : 你这么说什么意思？难道我不在的时候你们俩牵手了什么的？我现在该惩罚你吗？

lines.en: : Nothing’s happened. I just kind of figured-
lines.zh: : 什么都没发生。我只是有点觉得——

lines.en: : Figured what? That I called you up to here to get all possessive and jealous? Remind you of how I feel? Guilt trip you into never thinking about anyone else?
lines.zh: : 觉得什么？觉得我把你叫上来是要大发占有欲和醋意？提醒你我对你的感觉？用愧疚逼你再也不去想别人？

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t know if I’d put it {i}that{/i} way...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我不知道会不会说得{i}这么{/i}直白……

lines.en: : There are things in my life that don’t revolve around {i}you,{/i} you know.
lines.zh: : 你要知道，我的人生里有些东西并不绕着{i}你{/i}转。

lines.en: : Maybe I just needed somebody to talk to tonight?
lines.zh: : 也许我只是今晚需要有人陪我说说话？

lines.en: : Yuki {i}is{/i} hot, though, isn’t she? I wouldn’t blame you if you {i}did{/i} try something. I’d just, A, want to know about it. And, B, want to be involved.
lines.zh: : Yuki {i}很{/i}辣，对吧？你要是{i}真{/i}对她动了什么心思，我不会怪你。我只想，一，知道这件事。二，也要参与进来。

lines.en: : I will keep that in mind, but...what’s this about? Why are you acting different tonight?
lines.zh: : 我会记住的，不过……到底怎么了？你今晚怎么不一样？

lines.en: : Different? How so?
lines.zh: : 不一样？哪里不一样？

lines.en: : You’re normally...easier to read? And you feel weirdly...threatening just holding that smile this whole time.
lines.zh: : 你平时……更好懂？而且你从头到尾都挂着那个笑，让人莫名觉得……有威慑力。

lines.en: : You’re good.
lines.zh: : 你眼光不错。

lines.en: : To tell you the truth, I’m probably only one step away from breaking into a million pieces and bawling my eyes out all over you.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我大概只差一步就会碎成百万片，然后趴在你身上哭得稀里哗啦。

lines.en: : But you’ve seen me cry enough. And nothing’s ever gonna get any better or easier if I just let my tears do all of the talking for me.
lines.zh: : 但你已经看够我哭了。而且如果只让眼泪替我把话说完，什么都不会变好、变简单。

lines.en: : What’s going on? Tell me.
lines.zh: : 出什么事了？告诉我。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple8
: Do you like movies, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢电影吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : ...What?
scene black
Sara takes a step away from me and my attention is commandeered for a moment by the blinking red light of an air traffic tower outside of the window.
lines.zh: Sara 从我身边退开一步，我的注意力被窗外航空调度塔一闪一闪的红灯夺去了片刻。

lines.en: I question why it still blinks when nothing can go in or out. And I question why red was chosen when there are so many other colors that could be used instead.
lines.zh: 我疑惑它为什么还在闪，明明什么都不能进、什么都不能出。我也疑惑为什么会选红色，明明还有那么多别的颜色可以用。

lines.en: Control of my thoughts returns to me in the form of an invisible orb that floats into my mouth when I open it to take a breath.
lines.zh: 我思绪的掌控权以一个看不见的球体的形式回到我身上，那球体在我张嘴吸气时飘进了我嘴里。

lines.en: Inside of the orb is a small man who will live inside of me for the next twenty four hours and pilot my thoughts the way a pilot would pilot a plane if there was still a plane to pilot.
lines.zh: 球体里有个小男人，他会在我体内住上二十四小时，像飞行员驾驶飞机那样操纵我的思绪——如果这世上还有飞机可开的话。

lines.en: My name is Akira Arakawa and I don’t have any strong feelings about movies.
lines.zh: 我叫 Akira Arakawa，我对电影没什么强烈的感觉。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple9
: We all have things that help us keep our mind off of stuff.
lines.zh: : 我们都有帮自己不去想那些事的东西。

lines.en: : When I was younger, in between the beatings and making myself look pretty, it was movies.
lines.zh: : 我小的时候，在挨打和把自己打扮漂亮之间，是电影。

lines.en: : My favorite was one called Memento. Have you seen it?
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢的一部叫《记忆碎片》。你看过吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...no. I don’t think I have...
lines.zh: : 呃……没。我应该没看过……

lines.en: : Well, without getting too deep into it, it was about this guy with memory problems who would leave these messages for himself all over his body in the form of tattoos.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不往深了说，它讲的是一个有记忆问题的男人，用纹身的形式把留给自己的信息写满全身。

lines.en: : Every time he’d wake up, he’d see those messages and try and piece his life back together based on what they said. The whole movie plays out backwards.
lines.zh: : 每次醒来，他都会看到那些信息，然后试着根据上面写的内容把自己的生活拼回去。整部电影是倒着放的。

lines.en: : I think I was only nine or ten when it came out and probably shouldn’t have been watching it at that age, so I don’t think I really fully grasped it until way later.
lines.zh: : 我记得它上映的时候我才九岁或十岁，那个年纪大概不该看，所以我觉得到很后来我才真正看懂。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t even think I fully grasp it {i}now{/i} and I’ve seen it like a million times at this point.
lines.zh: : 事实上，就算{i}到现在{/i}我已经看了差不多一百万遍，我也不觉得自己完全看懂了。

lines.en: : But I liked it so much back then that I started writing things on myself. Sort of, you know, pretending to be the protagonist.
lines.zh: : 但我那时候太喜欢它了，于是开始往自己身上写字。算是，你知道的，假装自己是主角。

lines.en: : The only issue was I didn’t really have anything cool to write, so it wound up being nothing but mundane messages like, “Brush your teeth” or “Don’t touch anything in the fridge.”
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是我实在没什么酷的东西可写，所以最后写下来全是些无聊的话，比如“记得刷牙”或者“别碰冰箱里的东西”。

lines.en: : Is this some kind of metaphor or something? Because I doubt you called me up here just to talk about movies.
lines.zh: : 这是什么比喻之类的吗？我可不信你叫我上来只是为了聊电影。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple10

: I told you you’d have a lot of questions. But bear with me. This isn’t exactly an easy thing to talk about and I have to try and explain stuff before I start getting to the {i}real{/i} point I’m trying to make.
lines.zh: : 我说过你会有一堆问题。但先忍忍。这事真的不容易开口，而且在说到我{i}真正{/i}想讲的重点之前，我得先把一些东西解释清楚。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple11
: When life gets hard to live, it’s easy to just distract yourself with other things.
lines.zh: : 当日子变得难以为继时，人很容易用别的东西来转移注意力。

lines.en: : It’s easy to pick a hobby and run with it...completely forget about all of the bad stuff at home or how no one around ever wants to listen to you.
lines.zh: : 很容易挑一个爱好然后一路钻进去……彻底忘掉家里那些糟心事，或者身边从来没人愿意听你说话这件事。

lines.en: : But it’s easy to get lost in that kind of stuff as well.
lines.zh: : 但人也很容易在那类东西里迷失。

lines.en: : Once that happens, it's really tough to figure out the difference between what’s actually real and what’s just...stuff you forced into your head so that {i}other{/i} stuff would get pushed out.
lines.zh: : 一旦迷失，就真的很难分清什么才是真实的，什么只是……你硬塞进脑子里、好把{i}别的{/i}东西挤出去的东西。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple12
: It’s scary...never feeling like you’re in the {i}right{/i} world.
lines.zh: : 这很可怕……永远觉得自己不在{i}正确{/i}的那个世界里。

lines.en: : You know how sometimes shoelaces can get, like, an extra knot in the middle of them that just gets so tight you give up on ever untying it? It’s like that.
lines.zh: : 你知道鞋带有时候中间会多出一个结，紧到你干脆放弃再也解不开它吗？就是那种感觉。

lines.en: : You just kind of accept these little hiccups in your world and settle on things never going back to normal because it’s either too hard or you just don’t have the time or skill to fix it.
lines.zh: : 你只能接受你世界里这些小小的故障，认定一切再也回不到正常，因为这要么太难，要么就是你根本没有时间或本事去修好它。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple13
: The girl who stands before you is all knotted up inside.
lines.zh: : 站在你面前的这个女孩，里面全打了结。

lines.en: : After years and years of work, she realizes where she’s supposed to be and what parts of her are just made-up.
lines.zh: : 经过年复一年的努力，她终于认清了自己该在什么位置，也认清了自己身上哪些部分只是虚构出来的。

lines.en: : But now, she’s starting to think that’s not the result of her hard work at all.
lines.zh: : 可现在，她开始觉得那根本不是她努力的结果。

lines.en: : She’s starting to think that something {i}else{/i} she pushed out of her might have gotten tangled up in those laces...and pulled some of the extra knots out in the process.
lines.zh: : 她开始觉得，也许有{i}某个{/i}被她挤出去的东西缠进了那些鞋带里……并在这一过程中把多出来的结给拽开了。

lines.en: : Which brings me to the main point of all of this.
lines.zh: : 这就说到了我真正想讲的重点。

lines.en: : I need you to watch over my daughter.
lines.zh: : 我需要你替我照看好我的女儿。

lines.en: : I...don’t like how ominously you worded that. It makes it sound like you won’t be around much longer.
lines.zh: : 我……不喜欢你把话说得这么不祥。听起来像是你不久就要不在了。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple12
: Don’t worry. I’m not going anywhere so long as Sana is still here.
lines.zh: : 别担心。只要 Sana 还在这儿，我就哪儿也不去。

lines.en: : She’s growing up and doesn’t want me around her as much as I want to be around her. And that’s fine. I get it. I’m her mom and it’s embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 她在长大，不像我想陪她那样想让我陪着。这没关系，我懂。我是她妈妈，本来就挺难为情的。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple14
: But, at the same time...
lines.zh: : 但同时……

lines.en: : I passed something onto her that I can not take back and I am absolutely fucking terrified that she’s going to get just as lost inside of herself as I did.
lines.zh: : 我把一样东西传给了她，再也收不回来了，而我他妈的害怕极了，怕她会像我一样迷失在自己里面。

lines.en: : I can’t let that happen. But I also can’t {i}stop{/i} it from happening because I need to let her out of my sight in order for her to thrive.
lines.zh: : 我不能让那发生。可我也没法{i}阻止{/i}它发生，因为为了让她好好长大，我必须让她离开我的视线。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple15
: But then she’s out of my sight and I can’t stop thinking about her. And when I can’t stop thinking about her, I can’t stop blaming myself for things she might be seeing.
lines.zh: : 可她一离开我的视线，我就忍不住想她。一忍不住想她，我就忍不住责怪自己，怪她可能会看到的东西。

lines.en: : And I don’t want my daughter to end up like me. I don’t want her to get lost. I want her to have an entire support system of people who will help her get back on track. That means you.
lines.zh: : 我不想让我的女儿变成我这样。我不想让她迷失。我想让她身边有一整套会帮她回到正轨的支持系统。那包括你。

lines.en: : You can be that person. Sana won’t say no to {i}you{/i} always being around because she {i}likes{/i} you. You can do what I can’t. You can keep an eye on her {i}always.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你可以成为那个人。Sana 不会拒绝{i}你{/i}总在她身边，因为她{i}喜欢{/i}你。你能做到我做不到的事。你能{i}一直{/i}看着她。

lines.en: : I can’t do that {i}always,{/i} Sara. You know that.
lines.zh: : 我不可能{i}一直{/i}那样，Sara。你知道的。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple16
: Well, why not?! She’s the cutest, isn’t she?! She might be quiet, sure! But there’s no one in the world who’s cuter and better and nicer and sweeter than her! You should {i}want{/i} to be with her!
lines.zh: : 那为什么不行？！她最可爱了，不是吗？！她也许是安静了点，没错！但这世上再没有谁比她更可爱、更好、更善良、更贴心了！你应该{i}想{/i}和她在一起才对！

lines.en: : I do...and I’ll do what I can to help, but asking me to spend every waking moment focusing on Sana is just...
lines.zh: : 我是想……而且我会尽力帮忙，但你要我把清醒的每一刻都用来盯着 Sana，这就……

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple17
: What’ll it take?...
lines.zh: : 要怎样你才肯？……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Do you want the bar? The apartment? What can I do to make you change your mind? Name it. I’ll give you everything I have.
lines.zh: : 你想要这间酒吧？这套公寓？我要怎么做才能让你改变主意？说吧。我有的一切都给你。

lines.en: : Sara, your daughter’s going to be fine. I’ll keep an eye on her whenever I can.
lines.zh: : Sara，你女儿不会有事的。只要我能，我就会照看着她。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple18
: Have you at least noticed anything different?! Any changes in behavior?! Has she told you about {i}seeing{/i} anything?!
lines.zh: : 那你至少注意到什么不一样的地方了吗？！行为上有什么变化吗？！她跟你提过她{i}看见{/i}了什么吗？！

lines.en: : There’s...{i}a{/i} change in behavior I’ve noticed. But I’m not sure if that’s a new thing or just...something I refused to believe.
lines.zh: : 有……我注意到{i}一个{/i}行为上的变化。但我不确定那是新出现的，还是只是……我一直不肯相信的某件事。

lines.en: : What is it? What’s the change? I know her. I can help.
lines.zh: : 是什么？什么变化？我了解她。我能帮上忙。

lines.en: : Well...
: Well what? Just spill it.
lines.zh: : 嗯什么？直说。

lines.en: : {i}Well,{/i} at least two people have encountered her masturbating in a public bathroom recently.
lines.zh: : {i}嗯{/i}，最近至少有两次，有人撞见她在公共洗手间里自慰。

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple19
: Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : I mean...she {i}is{/i} at that age.
lines.zh: : 我{i}是{/i}说……她也到那个年纪了。

lines.en: : But I’m not really sure if that’s...{i}new{/i} or not.
lines.zh: : 但我真不确定那是不是……{i}新{/i}出现的问题。

lines.en: : What’s this about seeing things, though? Is that more of the...movie stuff you were talking about?
lines.zh: : 那你说的“看见东西”是怎么回事？那也是你刚才说的那种……电影之类的东西吗？

lines.en: scene returnofaweirdcouple20
: That was just a comparison I came up with to try and explain what was going on. It wasn’t like Guy Pearce was just wandering around in my imagination seeking vengeance. I just...
lines.zh: : 那只是我为了解释发生了什么想出来的一个比较。并不是说 Guy Pearce 真在我脑子里晃来晃去地寻仇。我只是……
